title: governance/signals.yml
description: Structural validator for Compass's signals.yml — the file that ships pattern defaults consumed by the stop-hook (scope-bloat phrases) and `compass rework-scan` (window + public-surface + migration patterns). Projects override by editing their own governance/signals.yml; the schema is the contract.

version.description: Semver. Bump on incompatible schema changes.

scope_bloat_phrases.description: Substrings searched in agent-authored text (devlog, verification-report) by the stop-hook to nudge a re-frame. Case-insensitive substring match — not regex.

window_days.description: Lookback window for `compass rework-scan`. Tasks landed outside this window are not considered as candidates for the add→delete pairing.

public_surface_patterns.description: Regex patterns for paths/symbols whose churn within window_days is reported as a separate signal class (public-surface rework).

migration_paths.description: Glob patterns for migration files whose churn within window_days is reported as a separate signal class (migration rework).

design_smell.description: Advisory patterns assessed by the reviewer agent at Verify — judgement, never a gate. A match is a nudge to investigate a potential design smell. Projects extend by editing their own signals.yml.
